evidence: In the orthographic 3d_top view all four relay bodies show clear board gaps between each other and the screw terminals sit adjacent but distinct below them; apparent terminal/relay overlap in the iso views is perspective only.
In both iso views every relay, terminal block, and SMD passive rests flush on the PCB surface with no floating, sunken, or tilted bodies visible.

Mapping 3d_top body positions to the 2D pad locations, each relay body covers its five pads, each terminal sits over its three pads, and the right-side L/C column aligns with its footprints with no displaced bodies.

All four screw terminals are at the bottom edge with wire openings facing outward, the relays form a uniform identically-oriented 1x4 row, and the diodes show identical orientation in every repeated channel.

The four relay channels have identical D/R/Q/D driver clusters grid-aligned above each relay, terminals form a straight bottom row, and the power filter parts (L1/L2/C1/C2) form a single tidy column at the group boundary.
